name: CENX/NEM Price Ratio Analysis
description: CENX/NEM price ratio with 60-day rolling mean ± 2σ bands and z-score. Identifies when the ratio is stretched to extremes (z > ±2.0). Event markers flag each extreme divergence.
source:
# CENX/NEM Price Ratio Analysis
# Ratio with 60-day rolling mean +/- 2 std dev bands and z-score
# Events fire when z-score crosses +/-2.0

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
nem = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()
cenx_close = src.c
nem_close = ffill(nem.c)

# --- Price Ratio ---
ratio = cenx_close / nem_close

# --- Rolling Statistics (60-day) ---
ratio_sma = ma(period=60, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)
ratio_std = stddev(period=60)(ratio)
upper_band = ratio_sma + 2.0 * ratio_std
lower_band = ratio_sma - 2.0 * ratio_std

# --- Z-Score (60-day) ---
ratio_z = zscore(window=60)(ratio)

# --- Percentile Rank (1-year lookback) ---
ratio_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(ratio)

# --- Extreme Detection (manual cross patterns — no crossover builtin) ---
# Rich: z was at/below +2.0 yesterday, above today
z_prev = ratio_z >> 1
is_rich = is_valid(ratio_z) and is_valid(z_prev) and ratio_z > 2.0 and z_prev <= 2.0
# Cheap: z crosses below -2.0
is_cheap = crossunder()(ratio_z, -2.0)
is_extreme = is_rich or is_cheap
regime_label = conditional_select(is_rich, "CENX Rich", is_cheap, "CENX Cheap", "")

# --- Timestamps ---
ts = index().value

# --- Chart 1: Price Ratio with Bollinger-Style Bands ---
xy_lines(
    title='CENX/NEM Ratio — Is the Spread Stretched?',
    category='Ratio Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Ratio',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='CENX/NEM Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d Mean', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='+2s Band', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='-2s Band', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(ratio, ratio_sma, upper_band, lower_band))

# --- Chart 2: Z-Score with Extreme Zones ---
xy_lines(
    title='How Extreme Is the Current Divergence?',
    category='Ratio Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Ratio Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='+2s Rich'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='-2s Cheap'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Fair Value')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=2.0, to=4.0, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.08, label='Rich'),
        PlotBand(from=-4.0, to=-2.0, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.08, label='Cheap')
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(ratio_z,))

# --- Event Markers: Extreme Divergences ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Ratio Extreme',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Signal', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Ratio Level', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Percentile', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(regime_label, ratio_z, ratio, ratio_pctrank, is_extreme)

# --- Summary Table: Current Snapshot ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Ratio Analysis',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='CENX/NEM Ratio Snapshot',
        row_size=2, col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Current', 'Context'],
        col_headers=['Ratio', 'Z-Score', 'Percentile'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, dp=3,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, dp=2,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, dp=0,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, dp=3,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Historical average ratio'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, dp=2,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Z-score volatility'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=0,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Median percentile')
        ]
    ),
    order=0
)(ratio, ratio_z, ratio_pctrank, ratio_sma, ratio_z, ratio_pctrank)
